en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, raising it, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to himasws, ‘Is there a known time for the Zakāt to be given during it?’ So heasws said: ‘That is different (based upon) the attain of the wealth by the man; and as for Al-Fitra, so it is known (time)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad in a marfu‘ manner from abu Basir who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, Is there a definite time to pay Zakat? He (the Imam) said, ‘That depends on one’s earnings. However, the time for al-Fitrah is definite.”’
